title: Home Purchase Financing Escrow and Hazard Coverage Settings by Program
content:
Hazard-insurance escrow on Home Purchase Financing is required on the four longer Home-Only Loan programs and optional on the two shorter ones. The other escrow and coverage settings are the same on every program.

| Setting | 7-Year Fixed | 10-Year Fixed | 15-Year Fixed | 20-Year Fixed | 23-Year Fixed | 25-Year Fixed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Escrow of hazard premiums required | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Escrow cushion (months of projected disbursements) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Months between escrow analyses | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Installments over which a shortage is spread | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Smallest surplus refunded in cash after an analysis (USD) | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| Calendar days after the analysis to pay a refundable surplus | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum dwelling coverage | not less than the unpaid principal | same | same | same | same | same |
| Fewest calendar days from the first lapse notice to the earliest lender-placed premium charge | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Fewest calendar days from the reminder lapse notice to the earliest lender-placed premium charge | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Calendar days after proof of the borrower's own coverage to refund overlapping lender-placed premium | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

(Programs are the Home-Only Loan programs of the same names.)

### Settings questions answered

**Which programs require escrow of hazard premiums?** The Home-Only Loan 15-Year, 20-Year, 23-Year and 25-Year Fixed programs. On the 7-Year and 10-Year Fixed programs escrow is not required.

**What does a surplus of 50.00 mean against the threshold?** A surplus of exactly 50.00 is at least the smallest refundable surplus; 49.99 is below it, and a smaller surplus is credited to next year's escrow.

**What is the minimum dwelling coverage on a loan with 41250.00 of unpaid principal (hypothetical)?** Not less than 41250.00, since coverage must be not less than the unpaid principal.
